full_details: On the post by the Bull, two bills, title only, no author on either. The Rose has The Disguises, a new one. The Theatre has The Tragedie of King Richard the second. You read the Rose's first, with half a mouth and a clove, and you did not look back. The rival title is for the tables, among the Rose's bills, not among things you have seen. You do not know what the Rose took. The morning rehearsal kept the fourth act as a report. The deposition stays cut. An hour before the doors the glass was on the throne. At half past one Garnish locked it in the property chest, and Richard would not say why. You spoke Gaunt. The line landed in a hush. You were dead by the middle of the second act and stood at the tiring-house door for the rest. Richard sat upon the ground. The crown changed heads between two speeches. The Abbot called it a woeful pageant the house had not been let behold. Kemp danced the jig like a man owed money. The boxes held eleven pound six. Pell's box was heavy, and the yard was quiet. The carrier is at the Bell today. Gilbert took the canvas last night. You do not go.
one_sentence: You read the Rose's new title first, played Gaunt to a hush, and heard the boxes hold eleven pound six.
title: The Disguises, Gaunt in a hush, and eleven pound six
